//: Story Phase 14: the Grand Bank's depositors arrive (out of the haze at the starboard end of the queue), state their titles, deposit, react, and dissolve. Rated by the teller after.
p14.bank.windabella.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. HER GRACE THE GRAND DUCHESS WINDABELLA THE IMPERIOUS, GRAND DUCHESS OF THE UPPER BREEZES, KEEPER OF THE CRIMSON SASH, PATRON OF THE ROYAL DRAUGHT.
windabella: (not looking at you) A deposit. One. Royal. You may take the sash.
p14.bank.windabella.after: The table by the mast goes four feet to the left. The Duchess does not look at it.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.gassius.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. SIR GASSIUS THUNDERBOTTOM, KNIGHT OF THE CEREMONIAL BEAN, THUNDERBOTTOM OF THUNDERBOTTOM HALL.
gassius: (clanking to attention) Burnt pepper, teller. The Thunderbottoms have eaten nothing else since the Siege of Gristlewick.
p14.bank.gassius.after: A crack runs up the mainmast, thinks about it, and stops.
gassius: STRUCTURAL! As Father would have wished.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.rumblewaft.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. LADY RUMBLEWAFT THE RESOLUTE, HOLDER OF THE LONG WAFT, PATIENCE OF THE SOUTHERN SHORE.
rumblewaft: (settling herself) Do make yourself comfortable, dear. I'm a little... sustained.
p14.bank.rumblewaft.after: It ends. Eventually. Somebody has made tea in the middle of it, and drunk it, and made more.
rumblewaft: Thank you, dear. That was the short one.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.puffington.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. THE RIGHT HONOURABLE LORD PUFFINGTON THE ENDURING, NINETY-SEVEN YEARS OF AGE.
puffington: (very slowly, leaning on a stick) Good morning, young man. Just a little one. At my age, you know.
captain[surprised]: (to Pete) Finally. A gentle one.
<k>Very old. Very frail. Seems quite harmless.</>
p14.bank.puffington.after: The starboard cannon rolls the length of the deck and stops against the bowsprit. Out at sea, a whale surfaces to see what's happened.
puffington: (doffing his hat) Fibre. Every morning. Never missed a day.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.breezella.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. GRAND STENCHMISTRESS BREEZELLA THE BOLD, YOUNGEST EVER CERTIFIED, RECORD HOLDER, NOUGHT TO STRUCTURAL.
breezella: (bouncing on her toes) Ready? Ready? Are you READY? I'm SO ready.
p14.bank.breezella.after: The pressure wave arrives a full second after she's finished, and folds the velvet rope in half.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.gustavius.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. LITTLE GRAND GUSTAVIUS, APPRENTICE GRAND STENCHMASTER, JUNIOR DIVISION, AGED SEVEN AND THREE QUARTERS.
gustavius: (very seriously) I'd like to make a deposit, please.
<k>A small boy in an enormous sash.</>
p14.bank.gustavius.after: The foremast's top yard swings right round and back. A gull that was sitting on it is now sitting on a different ship.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.puffalina.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. HER LITTLE GRACE THE GRAND TODDLER PUFFALINA, HEIRESS TO THE LITTLE BREEZE, AGED TWO.
captain[surprised]: (melting slightly) Aww. Course you can, sweetheart.
p14.bank.puffalina.after: The second one takes the bell off the counter, the forms out of their racks, and Bob's eyebrows.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.ventworth.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. DOCTOR FLATULON VENTWORTH, PROFESSOR OF APPLIED ATMOSPHERICS, FELLOW OF THE GRAND SOCIETY, AUTHOR OF 'ON THE RESONANCE OF THE LOWER WIND'.
ventworth: (adjusting his spectacles) Do note the frequency, teller. Two hundred and twelve cycles. I'm VERY consistent.
p14.bank.ventworth.after: The whole ship hums at two hundred and twelve cycles for a full minute after. Every cup in the galley sings.
ventworth: Exactly two-twelve. Lovely. Do write that down.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.windledger.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. MADAME WINDLEDGER, GRAND AUDITOR OF THE GRAND TRUST.
windledger: (peering at the ledger) Is that your handwriting? That's your handwriting. That's a FIVE? That looks like an S.
windledger: It looks like an S.
p14.bank.windledger.after: The teller counter, with you behind it, slides a full yard backwards across the deck.
windledger: (making a note) Counter: not secured. Handwriting: deplorable.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.gasbeth.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. CAPTAIN GASBETH, PIRATE GRAND STENCHMASTER, TERROR OF THE WINDWARD ISLES.
gasbeth: (grinning) Nice ship. Shame about the smell. Oh, wait. That's ME.
p14.bank.gasbeth.after: The port cannons roll back on their tackles, and the aft one goes off, by itself, at nothing.
gasbeth: (tipping her hat) Fire in the hole, Captain.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.thundergut.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. THE BARON THUNDERGUT, TRIPLE-SASH CERTIFIED.
thundergut: (holding out three sashes, each as long as a sail) All three, teller. Regulations.
pete: (taking hold of your belt) We've got you, Captain.
<k>Huge. Three sashes. You have to hold all three.</>
p14.bank.thundergut.after: The human chain holds. Just. Six pirates in a line, heels dug into the deck, and the Baron's deposit going over their heads like weather.
thundergut: (gathering his sashes) Good grip, that one.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.duke_puff.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. HIS GRACE THE GRAND MINIATURE DUKE PUFF, MASTER OF CONCENTRATED OUTPUT.
duke_puff: (on tiptoe, to see over the counter) Concentration is everything, teller. Everything.
p14.bank.duke_puff.after: Across the deck, the ship's bell, which he was nowhere near, splits neatly in two.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.wind_twins.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. THE GRAND WIND TWINS, JOINT ACCOUNT, THE SYNCHRONISED SASHES OF BREEZEMOUTH.
wind_twins: (in perfect unison) A JOINT deposit.
p14.bank.wind_twins.after: The two pressure waves meet exactly where you're standing. Your beard goes straight up.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.rumpington.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. HIS GRACE THE GRAND DUKE RUMPINGTON OF THE LOWER RUMPS, HEREDITARY BENCH-WARMER.
rumpington: (settling his velvet) One does like a branch with a VIEW.
<k>A great deal of velvet. A great deal of man.</>
p14.bank.rumpington.after: The bench by the rail goes over backwards, and so does Ned, who was on it.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.beatrice.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. BEATRICE OF THE VIOLET SASH.
<k>A violet sash. A very nice violet sash.</>
p14.bank.beatrice.after: The rope coils by the mast lift, turn over, and settle the other way up. Neater, if anything.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.gary.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. THE GRAND HIGH EXALTED AMBASSADOR OF THE TEMPESTUOUS BOTTOM, VISCOUNT OF THE SEVENTH GUST, KEEPER OF THE ETERNAL BEAN, FIRST OF HIS NAME...
p14.bank.gary.after: It's the loudest thing that's happened all day. Including the Baron. Out at sea, three separate sharks put their fins over their ears.
captain: (writing it down, underlining it, underlining it again) GARY.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.zephyrella.intro: The haze at the end of the queue goes dark, and then gold. The other depositors, the summoned ones still hanging about, kneel.
bank_voice: NEXT. HER IMPERIAL MAJESTY GRAND EMPRESS ZEPHYRELLA THE UNCONTAINABLE, GRAND EMPRESS OF THE FOUR WINDS, MOVER OF THE MOUNT OF OOMPH.
brogath[delighted]: (to you, starstruck) She MOVED a MOUNTAIN, Captain. Moved it. Six feet. They had to redraw the MAPS.
p14.bank.zephyrella.after: The sky goes dark gold. The Sharkstorm stops going round, for a full breath, and then remembers and starts again.
zephyrella: (leaving) Six feet. People always say six. It was SEVEN.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.rumbleseptimus.intro: bank_voice: NEXT. THE GRAND PATRIARCH RUMBLESEPTIMUS THE WORLD-WEARY, GRAND PATRIARCH OF THE FIRST RUMBLE, CONTINENTAL CLASS, RETIRED.
rumbleseptimus: (very, very slowly) I was old when your mountains were young, teller. Let's get this over with.
p14.bank.rumbleseptimus.after: Somewhere far to the east, a continent shifts in its sleep. The Revenge rides up the swell it makes, and down.
rumbleseptimus: (wearily) That used to be easier.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank.gustilda.intro: The last one. The haze at the end of the queue clears, and there's no fanfare. No glow. No kneeling.
Just a little old woman in a cardigan, with a knitted sash and a handbag.
A pause. The bank voice waits for a title. There isn't one.
captain[surprised]: (breathing out for the first time in an hour) Oh, thank goodness. Just a grandmother.
Behind you, very quietly, Brogath has gone white. All the way to the edges of the card.
p14.bank.gustilda.after: The bank counter goes up, with you on it. The whole crew go up with you, hanging off your legs. In the Sharkstorm, every shark turns round to look.
Far below, through two decks and a sealed door, the old cloud in the treasure room GROWLS back at her.
And then it's over, and the counter comes down, and you come down on top of it, and the crew come down on top of you.
gustilda: (patting her hair) There we are.

then: You get up off the deck. Your forms are in the rigging. Your beard is somewhere behind you.

p14.bank_vault: The deposit goes into the vault. The vault growls, satisfied. Somewhere inside it, something rattles its chains.
